mapper.select: select c.discrepancy_case_id, c.receipt_id, c.receipt_allocation_id, c.shipment_id, c.transfer_id, c.shipment_allocation_id, r.target_warehouse_id, ra.item_type, ra.item_id, ra.product_id, ra.tracking_policy, ra.damaged_quantity, ra.cost_price, ra.damaged_cost, ra.damaged_target_lot_id, ra.quarantine_location_id, ra.damaged_target_balance_id from inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_case c inner join inv_transfer_shipment_receipt r on r.receipt_id = c.receipt_id and r.shipment_id = c.shipment_id and r.transfer_id = c.transfer_id inner join inv_transfer_shipment_receipt_allocation ra on ra.receipt_allocation_id = c.receipt_allocation_id and ra.receipt_id = c.receipt_id and ra.shipment_id = c.shipment_id and ra.shipment_allocation_id = c.shipment_allocation_id where c.discrepancy_case_id = #{caseId} and c.discrepancy_type = 'damaged' and c.discrepancy_quantity = ra.damaged_quantity and c.source_cost_price = ra.cost_price and c.discrepancy_amount = ra.damaged_cost and ra.damaged_quantity > 0 and ra.damaged_target_lot_id is not null and ra.quarantine_location_id is not null and ra.damaged_target_balance_id is not null for update

select lot_id, lot_no, item_type, item_id, product_id, warehouse_id, source_lot_id, receipt_disposition, qc_status, lot_status from inv_inventory_lot where lot_id = #{fact.damagedTargetLotId} for update
select location_id, warehouse_id, location_code, location_name, location_type, sort_order, status, is_virtual from inv_warehouse_location where location_id = #{fact.quarantineLocationId} for update

select balance_id, item_type, item_id, product_id, warehouse_id, lot_id, location_id, current_quantity, locked_quantity, available_quantity, quarantine_quantity, cost_price, total_cost, version from inv_stock_balance_detail where balance_id = #{fact.damagedTargetBalanceId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into inv_stock_ledger_detail ( request_id, command_request_id, warehouse_id, item_type, item_id, product_id, movement_type, business_type, business_id, business_no, from_balance_id, from_lot_id, from_location_id, change_quantity, before_quantity, after_quantity, cost_price, total_cost, operator_user_id, operator_name, occurred_time, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{effect.stockLedgerRequestId}, #{effect.execution.requestId}, #{effect.fact.targetWarehouseId}, #{effect.fact.itemType}, #{effect.fact.itemId}, #{effect.fact.productId}, 'damage_write_off', 'transfer_discrepancy', #{effect.execution.caseId}, concat('adjudication-action:', #{effect.execution.actionId}), #{effect.balanceId}, #{effect.fact.damagedTargetLotId}, #{effect.fact.quarantineLocationId}, -#{effect.quantity}, #{effect.balanceCurrentBefore}, #{effect.balanceCurrentAfter}, #{effect.execution.sourceCostPrice}, #{effect.amount}, #{effect.execution.executorUserId}, #{effect.execution.executorName}, #{effect.execution.executedAt}, #{effect.execution.executorName}, sysdate(), concat('V2 damaged quarantine write-off, loss=', #{effect.lossType}) )
